module.title: Vertical mixing and mesoscale eddy parameterisations
entrypoints: verification/vermix (input, input.kpp, input.pp81, input.my82, input.ggl90, input.opps)
verification/MLAdjust (input, input.A4FlxF, input.AhFlxF, input.AhStTn, input.AhVrDv, input.QGLeith, input.QGLthGM)
module.expensive_path: KPP boundary-layer depth search and interior mixing coefficients (kpp_calc.F, kpp_routines.F: bulk Richardson number, shear and double-diffusion terms for every column and level), the GM/Redi isopycnal slope and tensor assembly (gmredi_calc_tensor.F, gmredi_xtransport/ytransport/rtransport) evaluated on every tracer at every step, and the GGL90 TKE closure with its implicit vertical solve.
module.rationale: These packages are column or tensor closures added on top of the dynamical core; they share the same hook (calc_diffusivity, the tracer flux divergence) and are validated by the vertical-mixing decks, so they are one task distinct from the core dynamics.
excluded: pkg/gmredi is also enabled in some ocean-dynamics and biogeochemistry decks; those decks grade other quantities
hazards: vermix is a single-column setup (1x1x26), cheap; runtime is scaled through nTimeSteps and tile count
KPP has a conditional branch structure (boundary-layer depth) that can amplify round-off into ulp-level differences in the mixed-layer depth

approval.human_ref: looks rather nice, lets go? (2026-09-02, all six modules approved; package mitgcm-seaice first)
